name: Checkbox
summary: A binary (or indeterminate) choice with a visible label, for forms and filters. Not for one-way actions with Undo (the ActionRow done ring is a Button), not for settings that apply the moment they change (Switch), not for mutually exclusive options (RadioGroup).

children.requiredWhen: aria-label is not given. The visible label is the default; the type union refuses a checkbox with neither.
children.intent: The visible label AND the accessible name. Rendered inside a real <label>, so clicking the text toggles the box — the whole row is the target.

aria-label.requiredWhen: children is omitted (a bare box in a table row: 'Select Orbit — Senior Product Designer').
aria-label.intent: Name without visible text. The name must still identify the thing being selected, not just say 'Select'.

isSelected.intent: Controlled checked state. Pair with onChange.

onChange.intent: Fires with the new boolean, not the event (React Aria convention, same shape across Inputs).

isIndeterminate.intent: Presentational 'mixed' state for a select-all box whose children disagree. Exposed through the native indeterminate property, which browsers report as aria-checked="mixed" (React Aria sets the property, not the attribute). The parent sets it from the children's state; the box never computes it. Clicking a mixed box selects (not clears), per APG.

description.intent: Help text under the label, linked by aria-describedby — e.g. what a consent actually permits.

errorMessage.intent: Shown when isInvalid. Present in the DOM before it becomes visible, so the announcement is immediate (same contract as TextField).

isInvalid.intent: Sets aria-invalid and the invalid style; the form decides validity (e.g. a required consent left unchecked on submit).

isRequired.intent: Sets aria-required plus the visible marker. Native required is not used (ADR-022), so the browser's bubble never competes with errorMessage.

isDisabled.intent: Removed from the tab order and from submission. Prefer isReadOnly when the state still matters to the user.

isReadOnly.intent: Focusable and announced, not toggleable, still submitted — a locked choice the user must be able to see.

value.intent: Native form value when submitted as part of a form.

size.intent: Row min-height 24 / 44 px (size.target.min / size.target.touch). The box itself is 1em of the label's text so it scales with zoom; md is dense-form density, lg is the touch default. No sm.

autoFocus.intent: Focus on mount. Only for a single primary control of a view; rarely right for a checkbox.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to / from the checkbox. Each checkbox is its own tab stop (unlike radios).
Toggles. Mixed → selected, selected → unselected, unselected → selected.
Does nothing on the box (native behaviour). Inside a <form> it submits the form; the checkbox must not intercept it.

a11y.name: From children (a real <label> wrapping the input), or aria-label when children is omitted — the type union requires one of the two.
a11y.announcements: aria-checked true / false from the native input; "mixed" comes from the native indeterminate property that React Aria sets (no attribute in the DOM). isInvalid → aria-invalid="true" and aria-describedby lists description then error. isRequired → aria-required="true". isReadOnly → aria-readonly="true"; still focusable and read.
a11y.targetSize: The whole label row is the target: md ≥ 24 px tall (2.5.8 AA minimum), lg ≥ 44 (touch). A bare box without a label still gets a 24 px hit area around its 16 px glyph.

rules: The ActionRow 'done' ring is NOT a Checkbox. It is a one-way action with an Undo toast — specs/HANDOFF.md makes it a <button aria-label="Mark done: {title}">. A checkbox promises a toggle; a done ring does not toggle back, it undoes. Build it as a Button variant in the pattern.
Selected is never colour-only: the check-mark glyph is drawn AND aria-checked is set. A filled square with no glyph fails 1.4.1 for colour-blind users and says nothing to a screen reader.
Indeterminate is presentational (React Aria's term): the parent computes it from the children and passes it in; the box never flips itself to mixed. Clicking a mixed box selects, never clears (APG).
Space toggles; Enter does not — do not add an Enter handler 'for convenience'. Enter belongs to the form.
The label is a real <label> wrapping the input, so clicking anywhere on the text toggles. Never a <span> with an onClick.
The error element is in the DOM before it is visible (same mechanism as TextField, ADR-022: validationBehavior="aria").

Focus ring is outline + outline-offset on the box, never box-shadow alone. In forced-colors mode the box keeps a FieldText border and the glyph uses the system colour, so a checked box is still distinguishable in Windows High Contrast.
A group of related checkboxes gets a <fieldset> + <legend> (CheckboxGroup, later) so the group name is announced once; do not fake it with a heading.

properties.State: browser states (default/hover/focus) + isSelected + isIndeterminate + isInvalid + isDisabled + isReadOnly
properties.Label: children
properties.Error: errorMessage (boolean show + text; visible only when State = invalid)

examples.title: Consent with description, required
examples.code: <Checkbox isRequired description="We store the lead in your tracker only." isInvalid={!agreed && submitted} errorMessage="Tick to continue">I agree to the terms</Checkbox>

examples.title: Bare box in a table row
examples.code: <Checkbox aria-label="Select Orbit — Senior Product Designer" isSelected={selected.has(id)} onChange={toggle(id)} />
